## Proof

**Identifying the scheme.** Let $A = k[V] = k[x_1,\dots,x_n]/I(V)$ be the coordinate ring of $V$. Since $V$ is irreducible, $I(V)$ is prime, so $A$ is an integral domain. The space $X$ of all closed irreducible subsets of $V$ is in bijection with $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$: a closed irreducible subset $V' \subseteq V$ corresponds to the prime ideal $\mathfrak{p} = I(V')/I(V) \in \operatorname{Spec}(A)$, and conversely every prime ideal of $A$ arises this way. The Zariski topology on $X$ coincides with the Zariski topology on $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$. The map $f(x) = \overline{\{x\}} = \{x\}$ identifies $V$ with the closed points of $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$ (via the Nullstellensatz, using that $k$ is algebraically closed). The ringed space $(X, f_*\mathcal{O}_V)$ is the affine scheme $\operatorname{Spec}(A)$.

**Computing the residue field.** Let $V' \in X$, corresponding to $\mathfrak{p} = I(V')/I(V) \in \operatorname{Spec}(A)$. The residue field of the scheme $X = \operatorname{Spec}(A)$ at $\mathfrak{p}$ is, by definition,
$$\kappa(\mathfrak{p}) = \mathcal{O}_{X,\mathfrak{p}} / \mathfrak{m}_\mathfrak{p} = A_\mathfrak{p}/\mathfrak{p}A_\mathfrak{p}.$$

There is a canonical isomorphism
$$A_\mathfrak{p}/\mathfrak{p}A_\mathfrak{p} \;\cong\; \operatorname{Frac}(A/\mathfrak{p}).$$

This is standard: localizing $A$ at $\mathfrak{p}$ and then quotienting by $\mathfrak{p}A_\mathfrak{p}$ is the same as localizing $A/\mathfrak{p}$ at $(0)$, which produces the fraction field of the integral domain $A/\mathfrak{p}$ (integral because $\mathfrak{p}$ is prime).

**Relating $A/\mathfrak{p}$ to the coordinate ring of $V'$.** By the third isomorphism theorem:
$$A/\mathfrak{p} = \big(k[x_1,\dots,x_n]/I(V)\big)\big/\big(I(V')/I(V)\big) \cong k[x_1,\dots,x_n]/I(V') = k[V'].$$

Since $V'$ is irreducible, $I(V')$ is prime, so $k[V']$ is an integral domain.

**Identifying with $K(V')$.** The field of rational functions of the variety $V'$ is defined as
$$K(V') = \operatorname{Frac}(k[V']).$$

Combining the isomorphisms above:
$$\kappa(\mathfrak{p}) \;\cong\; \operatorname{Frac}(A/\mathfrak{p}) \;\cong\; \operatorname{Frac}(k[V']) \;=\; K(V').$$

**Conclusion.** For every $V' \in X$, the residue field of the scheme $X$ at $V'$ is isomorphic to the field of rational functions $K(V')$ of $V'$. The statement is **true**.
